statement: ∀ (q : ℝ) (U : Set (YuiEucl n)) (d : ℝ), 0 < q → 0 < d → d ≤ 1 → ENNReal.ofReal d = Metric.ediam U → ∃ (N : ℕ) (V : Fin N → Set (YuiEucl (n+1))), {z : YuiEucl (n+1) | YuiHead z ∈ U ∧ YuiLast z ∈ YuiI} ⊆ ⋃ j, V j ∧ (∀ j, Metric.ediam (V j) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt 2*d)) ∧ YuiCost (q+1) V ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2*(Real.sqrt 2)^(q+1)) * (Metric.ediam U)^q
proof:
intro q U d hq hd hd1 heq
obtain ⟨N, hN, hlen, hmult, hcover⟩ := yui_aux_0002 n E h_T003 h_T007 d hd hd1
let V : Fin N → Set (YuiEucl (n+1)) := fun j => {z | YuiHead z ∈ U ∧ YuiLast z ∈ Set.Icc ((j : ℝ)/N) (((j : ℝ)+1)/N)}
have hdiam : ∀ j, Metric.ediam (V j) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt 2*d) := by
  intro j
  apply yui_aux_0004 n E h_T003 h_T007 U d _ _ hd.le heq.ge
  calc
    ((j : ℝ)+1)/N - (j : ℝ)/N = 1/(N : ℝ) := by ring
    _ ≤ d := hlen
refine ⟨N, V, ?_, hdiam, ?_⟩
· intro z hz
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcover (YuiLast z) hz.2
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hz.1, hj⟩
· calc
    YuiCost (q+1) V ≤ ∑' j : Fin N, (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt 2*d))^(q+1) := by
      apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
      intro j
      apply iSup_le
      intro _
      exact ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (hdiam j) (by linarith)
    _ = (N : ℝ≥0∞) * (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt 2*d))^(q+1) := by
      simp [tsum_fintype]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2*(Real.sqrt 2)^(q+1)) * (ENNReal.ofReal d)^q :=
      yui_aux_0006 n E h_T003 h_T007 d (Real.sqrt 2) q N hd (by positivity) hmult
    _ = _ := by rw [heq]

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YuiEucl n)),
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      (∀ (x : YuiEucl k) (t : ℝ), YuiHead (YuiSnoc x t) = x ∧ YuiLast (YuiSnoc x t) = t) ∧
        (∀ (z : YuiEucl (k + 1)), YuiSnoc (YuiHead z) (YuiLast z) = z) ∧
          (∀ (x y : YuiEucl k) (t u : ℝ), dist (YuiSnoc x t) (YuiSnoc y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
            LipschitzWith 1 YuiHead ∧ LipschitzWith 1 YuiLast) →
    (1 ≤ n →
        ∀ (q : ℝ),
          dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q →
            ∀ (r ε : ℝ),
              0 < r →
                r ≤ 1 →
                  0 < ε →
                    ∃ T U,
                      E ⊆ ⋃ i, U i ∧
                        (∀ (i : ↑T), (U i).Nonempty ∧ 0 < Metric.ediam (U i) ∧ Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r) ∧
                          YuiCost q U < ENNReal.ofReal ε) →
      ∀ (q : ℝ) (U : Set (YuiEucl n)) (d : ℝ),
        0 < q →
          0 < d →
            d ≤ 1 →
              ENNReal.ofReal d = Metric.ediam U →
                ∃ N V,
                  {z | YuiHead z ∈ U ∧ YuiLast z ∈ YuiI} ⊆ ⋃ j, V j ∧
                    (∀ (j : Fin N), Metric.ediam (V j) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (√2 * d)) ∧
                      YuiCost (q + 1) V ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * √2 ^ (q + 1)) * Metric.ediam U ^ q
